blocks.text:
After breakfast, you can take another walk to the falls before departure.

A transfer then takes you to the airport for your flight to Maceió via Rio de Janeiro. Domestic flights are paid for separately.

On arrival in Maceió, the beach part of your journey begins. A private transfer with English-speaking assistance takes you to Kenoa Exclusive Beach Spa & Resort, close to a nature reserve.

Accommodation is in an Apoena Suite with breakfast. The 45 m² suite has a terrace with panoramic coastal views, an interior garden in the bathroom and a Japanese ofuro soaking tub made from aromatic cedar.

The rest of the day is free after your flight.
